query: What are the sanctions for a Tier 3 academic integrity violation at VinUni?
assistant_text:
At VinUniversity, a Tier 3 academic integrity violation is part of a system that categorizes violations into four tiers based on severity. While the specific sanctions for Tier 3 violations are not detailed in the retrieved policy, the university outlines that penalties and outcomes depend on the severity of the incident and the student's history of violations.

Here are some key points from the **VinUni Student Academic Integrity Policy**:

1. **Tier Classification**: Violations are categorized from Tier 1 (mildest) to Tier 4 (most serious). The university uses this tier system to determine appropriate penalties.
2. **Investigation Process**: If a course instructor suspects academic dishonesty, they will gather evidence and investigate the case. Students can also report suspected violations.
3. **Sanctions**: The university does not provide an exhaustive list of violations or sanctions, but the severity of the violation will guide the determinations.

For more detailed information, you can refer to the [VinUni Student Academic Integrity Policy](https://policy.vinuni.edu.vn) (effective from September 30, 2022).

results.title: VinUni Student Academic Integrity Policy
results.section: 6. Procedures on reporting cases of academic integrity violations
results.facts: - If a course instructor/teaching assistant suspects a case of academic dishonesty in any assignments/tests/projects/quizzes, or is alerted to a case, she/he shall gather all evidence (softcopy and/or hardcopy of the students’ work, details of course assignments/tests/projects/quizzes and other pertinent materials) and investigate the case. - If a student wishes to report a suspected case of academic dishonesty, she/he may do so using the online form. - The instructor may take action appropriate to the level of the suspected violation, as described in this document. - Cases of major infringements or repeated violations (Tier 4 in Section 5) must be referred to the University Academic Integrity Council with all supporting documents and/or observations.

results.title: VinUni Student Academic Integrity Policy
results.section: 7. Academic integrity violations and possible sanctions
results.facts: Academic dishonesty can be of various types. The university has determined the appropriate penalties and outcomes depending on the severity of the incident and the history of violations by the individual student. The violations are split into four Tiers: Tier 1 is the mildest form of violation and Tier 4 is the most serious violation. While it is not possible to have an exhaustive list of all possible violations or sanctions, the determinations will be guided by the severity of the violations as illustrated in the tables below.

results.title: VinUni Student Academic Integrity Policy
results.section: TIER 1 VIOLATIONS: Verbal Warning by the Instructor
results.facts: Description A Tier 1 violation occurs when a student’s act of academic dishonesty (1) appears unintentional, or (2) can be reasonably attributed to a lack of understanding of instructor expectations or academic conventions, or (3) or considered minor or developmental in nature. Instructors can decide whether multiple Tier 1 violations in their course will be treated as a Tier 2 violation. Examples - Excessive collaboration in laboratory work - Poor citations or referencing - Re-using parts of assignments from one course to another - Attempting to seek the attention of a student during exams without instructor permission (refer to Appendix 4 for integrity expectations during exams) - Attempting to bring unauthorized items to exams Possible Outcomes
